excludedFactTypes.CustomerPattern: Deferred by spec #48 grilling decision 5, and NOT because it is hard. FR-30 defines it narrowly and warns by name against 'rep tactics, judgments, or selling approach', and ADR-0035 names an entity-less observation slot as the natural drain for exactly the rep-level inference ADR-0033 exists to prevent. Its false positives are aperture BREACHES rather than noise — a wrong QuoteGiven is a wrong number in a record the rep can correct, a wrong CustomerPattern is the rep's employer reading a judgment about the rep. Precision measured across the two would average a recoverable error with an unrecoverable one and report a single reassuring number. It joins this corpus when it is extracted, with its own labels and — this is the part that must not be skipped — its own reported number beside the others, never folded in.
